description: This PHP file defines an Upgrade controller class for the OpenCart admin tool, responsible for handling the upgrade process including checking the latest version, downloading upgrade packages, and installing updates.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Controller class for managing the upgrade process in the admin panel of OpenCart. Handles version checks, downloading upgrade packages, and applying updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that displays the upgrade status page, including current and latest versions, and whether an upgrade is available.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading of the specified version's zip package from GitHub, with permission and version validation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the installation of the downloaded upgrade package by extracting the upload files from the zip archive and placing them into the OpenCart directory.
